maintenance_items.description: EVs use regenerative braking, so friction brakes wear much slower. Still, inspect annually for corrosion.

maintenance_items.label: Battery cooling system
maintenance_items.description: The battery cooling system is vital for maintaining optimal temperature and prolonging cell life.

maintenance_items.label: Inverter / motor coolant
maintenance_items.description: The power electronics and electric motor generate heat. Coolant prevents overheating and component failure.

maintenance_items.label: Drive unit oil
maintenance_items.description: The reduction gear in the drive unit has its own oil. Change intervals vary by manufacturer.
EVs recirculate cabin air more frequently. Replace sooner for better air quality, especially with climate control use.
